data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2021 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were $485.17m. During the 2021 year the Syndicate recorded a gross prior-year movement of +$24.139m (an increase of c.5.0% of opening gross reserves), i.e. an overall strengthening of prior-year reserves on a gross basis. Management commentary references a detailed Q4 2021 review and describes favourable improvements to 2019 and earlier year reserves, but the technical provisions movement note shows a gross increase of $24.139m (net movement higher after reinsurance effects). The movement reflects reserve re-estimation and changes to prior-year IBNR / assumptions rather than a single named event.

data.data_quality_notes: All amounts are reported in the Syndicate's functional currency (USD) and have been converted from the $'000 presentation into millions. The primary prior-year movement source is Note 19 'Technical provisions' (the 'Change in prior year provisions' gross column = 24,139 $'000). There is an apparent tension between management commentary referencing 'favourable improvements' to 2019 and prior year reserves and the Note 19 gross movement (an increase). Users should note that management commentary may refer to prior internal movements or net impacts after reinsurance; the figure provided here is the gross insurance liabilities movement per the technical provisions note. Claims development triangle is present and has been provided as a cross-check. Amounts have not been converted to GBP despite key names containing '_gbp_m' - values are in the native USD per report instructions.
